dehydrated_text:
So listen, this already makes sense because in the universe death doesn't exist; after you die, your soul goes up to the astral plane to the vine. Your soul can never die. But you have to recognize that you are the divine spark. Once you recognize that, you'll be immortal. If you don't recognize it, you fear death. Jesus said, "Let him who seeks continue seeking until he finds."

When he finds, he will become troubled. When he becomes troubled, he will be astonished and he will rule over all. This goes back to Plato's allegory of the cave, where a prisoner escapes his chains, goes up into the real world with sunlight, sees the truth, and now rules because he knows it whereas everyone else is still in darkness. Remember that this process is painful; when you go in the light, you're blinded by it. You feel pain and confusion but persisting will reveal the truth.

Jesus said, "If those who lead you say to you, see the kingdom is in the sky, then the birds of the sky will precede you. If they say to you, it is in the sea," then the fish will precede you. Rather, the kingdom is inside of you and outside of you. When you come to know yourself, then you will become known and realize that you are the sons of a living father. But if you do not know yourselves, you dwell in poverty.

This is really important: when you escape the cave and see the real world, it doesn't matter if you tell others what you've seen; they have to go out and experience it themselves. They must break their chains and venture into the light before recognizing the truth. Jesus says organized religion does not work; he would never say follow me or believe in me because you have to believe in yourself. The divine spark is inside of you.

Also, all this contradicts modern-day Christianity because Jesus was not a Christian. He doesn't refer to Adam and Eve, Yahweh, David, or Moses; for him, the Bible is fake. All this is contradictory modern-day Christianity because Jesus was not a Christian. He saw infants being suckled and said, "These infants being suckled are like those who enter the kingdom."
